onboarding.title: Complete your profile
onboarding.intro: Before you can start using the workspace, please fill in the information below. Your administrator decides what's required.
onboarding.loadError: We couldn't load the onboarding form. Please refresh the page or contact support.

members.formEditorDescription: Drag fields in to design what every new member must fill in. Required fields are enforced when a user joins or logs in next.

invite.title: Invite a new user
invite.description: Send an invitation email. The recipient will create their account and join your organization.
invite.descriptionWithRole: The recipient will be assigned to this role automatically after they accept and complete onboarding.
invite.successMessage: Invitation sent. They'll receive an email shortly.

acceptInvite.loggedOutPrompt: You've been invited as {email}. Sign in or create an account to accept.
acceptInvite.wrongAccountBody: You're signed in as {current}, but the invitation is for {invited}. Sign out and try again.
acceptInvite.missingToken: The invitation link is missing a token.
acceptInvite.notFound: We couldn't find this invitation. The link may have been mistyped or already used.
acceptInvite.acceptedDescription: This invitation has already been accepted. Sign in to access your organization.
acceptInvite.revokedDescription: Your administrator revoked this invitation. Contact them if you think this is a mistake.
acceptInvite.expiredDescription: This invitation expired. Ask your administrator to send a new one.

errors.email_invalid: That email address doesn't look right.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member of your organization.
errors.pending_exists: There's already a pending invitation for this email.
errors.create_failed: We couldn't create the invitation. Please try again.
errors.submission_failed: We couldn't save your information. Please try again.
errors.email_mismatch: The invitation was sent to a different email.
errors.already_accepted: The invitation has already been accepted.
errors.not_verified: Verify your email address before accepting the invitation.
errors.accept_failed: We couldn't accept the invitation. Please try again.
errors.missing_token: The invitation link is missing a token.
